runtime.collision: Use the existing procedural enemy capsule/hurtbox. Do not derive physics from the mesh.

provenance.animationSource: Blender-authored Dread v02 gait, lunge, recoil, and collapse clips

motionValidation.gates: shuffle foot transfer, attack bodyweight/head cue, hit recoil

gaitTempo.note: Runtime scales the in-place contact/transfer cycle from measured root speed; no IK or root translation is baked into the clip.

compression.geometry: Meshoptimizer simplifier ratio 0.35, border locked; no runtime decoder required

rig.notes: Meshy/Blender export faces +Z; wrapper applies a PI yaw so the runtime actor presents local -Z while preserving the authored 1.86m scale.

idle.name: AshWitness_Idle
idle.purpose: Quiet breathing and a restrained head cant.

shuffle.name: AshWitness_Shuffle
shuffle.purpose: Six-pose contact/transfer zombie gait with delayed head and asymmetric arms.

attack.name: AshWitness_AttackLunge
attack.purpose: Short in-place bodyweight lunge timed to the melee strike window.

hit.name: AshWitness_HitRecoil
hit.purpose: Delayed head and torso recoil for flash/stagger feedback.

collapse.name: AshWitness_Collapse
collapse.purpose: Forward fold for death or a brief scare beat.

integration.transition: locomotion weights crossfade through 0.085s in / 0.11s out; attack/hit use LoopOnce and clampWhenFinished
integration.fallback: If the GLB is unavailable, retain the current procedural enemy factory.
